depictions.name: Temple of Ptah
depictions.text: Memphis, Egypt#Great Temple of Ptah The Temple of Ptah was a major temple complex located in the city of Memphis, Egypt, dedicated to the creator god, Ptah. The temple was also home to the Apis, a sacred bull worshipped by ancient Egyptians as an aspect of Ptah.
